title: LLV-G375LF: longer finishing gives classical-space growth index1/8

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the single LLV-G375LF configuration in proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch, charged sequential work is O(2^((3/8)sqrt nlog2n+(1/2)sqrt n+2n^(7/16))), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index1/2. The main branch n>=2^4096 computes v=floor(sqrt n),r=ceil(sqrt n),ell=ceil(log2n),a=ceil(n^(3/8)),P_prec=ceil(n^(1/16)),B_src=floor(v/2)-2a-100ell-2,H_prec=bit_length(a^P_prec-1),m=floor(P_prec*B_src/H_prec),kappa=ceil(log2(m+2a))+3,lambda=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*(a-1))). It uses2a binary finishing levels and Dbar=2^(2a+1)K*lambda*a^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. Section8 proves finishing feasibility under lambda>=2kappa+1, Section9 updates height and full leaf multiplicity, and Section14 charges the full finishing factor on every branch. The finite exhaustive branch, fixed Grover schedules, phase instrument, caps and all-modulus decoders are explicit. All arithmetic, serial lookup/list exclusion, circuit generation, addressing, resets, measurements, discarded work and cleanup are charged, jointly with all other claims.

For the same LLV-G375LF configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical workspace is O(2^((3/4)n^(1/8)log2n+3n^(1/16))) bits, with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index1/8. Section14 derives lambda at most(3/4)n^(1/8)log2n+2n^(1/16)+o(n^(1/16)); the positive unit gap absorbs all fixed polynomial storage factors. Full-label tables, residue arrays, verified tuple lists, schedules, counters, caps, arithmetic, extraction and streamed decoders are included, jointly with unconditional success and all other claims.

For the same LLV-G375LF algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak quantum allocation on EVERY branch is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant, including all retained phase inputs, variable-arity siblings, finishing levels, fresh U=a*lambda search registers, reusable oracle and reflection scratch, rank/projection registers, source transforms and extraction ancillas. Each search trial resets/releases its ancillas before the next trial. The exact uniform envelope n has growth index0, jointly with success at least1-2^-8 and all other resource/error claims.

For the same LLV-G375LF algorithm/configuration and every N,s, all fresh source copies acquired on EVERY branch, including rejected, failed, discarded and aborted copies, number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)) with an absolute outside constant. The literal main hard cap nCcap+K is at most2^((1/2)sqrt n) by the exact integer depth budget m*H_prec<=P_prec*B_src, with Dbar=2^(2a+1) K lambda a^m,Dcap=2^12 nDbar,Ccap=2^13 nDbar. The exact envelope has growth index1/2, jointly with full-secret success and all other resource and error claims.

For the same LLV-G375LF algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
